c1.note: Gong's boilerplate states the Revenue AI OS unifies data, insights and workflows into a single trusted system that observes, guides and acts; this is the current company description.

c5.note: The Nov 4, 2026 release quotes Bendov: 'The next phase is about agents that don't just surface insights, but take action and deliver results at enterprise scale.'

c6.note: On Sept 30, 2026 Bendov announced Gong Activate and said 'For years, AI told you how to win. Now, AI wins deals for you.' That is 41 days before today.

c7.note: Celebrate '26 release says Bendov discussed the next evolution of Revenue AI and announced Gong Activate; the Nov 4 quote on agents that act at scale is confirmed. 'Keynoted' and 'AI that sells' are mild paraphrase.

c8.note: Exact quote from the Gartner MQ Leader release, dated Oct 16, 2026 on the newsroom listing, within 90 days.

c9.note: Reshef is quoted on Big Dipper (blog dated Jun 24, 2026) and on Callisto/Enrich ('AI working from the full picture'); the Big Dipper date is older than 90 days, but the person claim is current.

c10.note: The Mission Callisto blog is authored by Reshef, CPO and Co-Founder, and was published Sept 30, 2026, covering context, agentic execution and measuring results.

c11.note: Reshef is quoted saying Enrich extends context to every account and contact and 'flows straight back into the Revenue Graph', in a release dated Sept 30, 2026.

c12.note: Both quotes are verified: the Enrich quote in the Sept 30 release and the 'Every revenue leader has AI...' quote in the June Big Dipper release.

c13.note: Nov 4, 2026 release announces Shtraichman as Chief R&D Officer; the excerpt says he will lead R&D and expand agentic capabilities across the Revenue Graph, Revenue Harness and Revenue Operating Surfaces.

c14.note: Release says Shtraichman previously led the global engineering org at monday.com and drove its AI-native transition. The pronoun 'she' in variants is unsupported but immaterial.

c15.note: Release announces Havusha as CISO on Nov 4, 2026 with global security experience. The 'promoted' wording in some variants and the privacy/compliance detail are not directly shown but are plausible.

c18.note: The Celebrate '26 recap quotes Shane Evans on effectiveness x efficiency = productivity and on the Revenue Graph in Gong's own transformation.

c19.note: Simon Frey, Chief Customer Officer, hosted the Executive Showcase with leaders from Experian, Thomson Reuters, Adyen and Snowflake.

c20.note: Simon Frey's Oct 6, 2026 post on measurable ROI and intent separating AI leaders from buyers supports the framing.

c21.note: Kavita Patel, Director Product Legal, published the governance post on Aug 27, 2026; its four sections match the claim.

c22.note: Mission Big Dipper and the Revenue Harness launched Jun 24, 2026, which is outside 90 days, but the Nov 4 release cites them as ongoing.

c23.note: Gong Activate was announced Sep 30, 2026 with agents and reps working from one blueprint; the press release does not say it is generally available.

c24.note: Activate, Agent Builder and Deep Mode are confirmed, and the Nov 4 release frames the move from insight to action at scale.

c26.note: Gong Enrich expands the Revenue Graph with third-party account and contact data to close data gaps (Sep 30, 2026).

c27.note: The release states Gong Enrich and Deep Mode are now generally available, with provider ordering and Gong Credits for gaps.

c29.note: All 10 named data partners are listed, with remaining gaps filled through Gong Credits.

c30.note: Agent Builder, Deep Mode and the Revenue Harness execution and governance layer are all described in the saved pages.

c31.note: November release notes describe multi-step Custom Agents, templates and MCP connections to Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, rolling out through November.

c32.note: Sept 30, 2026 release: Deep Mode GA, Assistant embedded in Deal/Account Boards, builds Engage Flows from natural language; within 90 days.

c33.note: Press release states Dashboards expand to full revenue lifecycle with metrics defined once in Data Studio.

c34.note: Mission Callisto and Dashboards with measurement feeding back to action; auto-triggered agents rolling out in 2026.

c35.note: Nov 4, 2026 appointment of Chief R&D Officer to expand agentic capabilities.

c36.note: Nov 4 release names Shtraichman CRDO and Havusha CISO (promoted from VP Platform Security) leading security, privacy, compliance.

c37.note: CISO appointment plus Revenue Harness with scoped data access, audit trails, human oversight are in the release; framing as differentiator is interpretive.

c38.note: Celebrate '26 recap cites ramp time reduction 30% and attainment up over 50%; productivity framing is consistent.

c39.note: Cisco 18,000 licenses/32% larger deals, AT&T 54%, Anthropic 64% and 77% non-selling time are all in passages (some from May release).

c40.note: Cisco 26% win rates, AT&T 54%, Experian 25% confirmed.

c41.note: May 12, 2026 release confirms figures; it is outside 90 days but remains the current growth state.

c42.note: May release states 50% multi-product, more $1M+ customers in two quarters than prior six, half of Fortune 10; describes current state.

c43.note: Gong frames AI needing deep context to be trusted; Activate and Revenue Harness are positioned as responses. 'Challenge' is Gong's own framing.

c44.note: Blog describes scattered third-party data and Enrich as the fix; it is a market problem Gong addresses, not a company pain.

c45.note: Recap and press framing on disconnected AI experiments and connected revenue execution; generic customer-side challenge rather than Gong's own.

c47.note: The April 15, 2026 release reports 46% of planned AI investments stalled on trust concerns, with a Jan 6-9 survey; it is market-wide and about 7 months old, so outside the 90-day window.

c48.note: The Calcalist interview says customers left in 2023 for competing bundles and that the next growth engine must be built before the product hits a ceiling; the Microsoft point is supported only indirectly and the Oct 2026 date is plausible.

c49.note: Sacra's 'Gongification' section lists HubSpot, Pipedrive, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clari, Outreach, 6sense and Gainsight, and the competitive pressure is ongoing.

c50.note: The source confirms the Dec 3, 2025 merger close, the April 15, 2026 release and the Sep 2, 2026 Salesloft rebrand, and says Gong Forecast must compete with Clari Forecast; it is a competitor-published source.

c51.note: Sacra confirms the $4.5B secondary in Nov 2025 against $7.25B at the 2021 Series E, and says it provided liquidity; it is about a year old, so context only.

c53.note: Sacra states the 2022-23 slowdown hurt per-seat pricing and net dollar retention, followed by a 2024 re-acceleration to $500M ARR in May 2026; the pricing headwinds are historical.

c55.note: The passages support add-ons raising cost 20-50% and auto-renewals with 5-10% uplifts; the $55.3K median appears elsewhere in the same article, and the source is a competitor.

c56.note: The 152 vs 2,983 review counts are confirmed; the G2 'call issues' and 'recording issues' counts are not in the passages, and the point is minor.

c57.note: Gong's June 19, 2026 post confirms the third-party Klue incident with no direct breach and no recording impact, and Klue's July 27 post confirms integrations were restored, so it is resolved.

c58.note: The Gartner page shows the April 15, 2026 critical review about limited integration and extra fees, and the provider excerpt covers the April 29 review; these are individual opinions from about 7 months ago.

c59.note: The Nov 4, 2026 press release confirms Shtraichman as Chief R&D Officer and Havusha as CISO, both previously at monday.com; the 'promoted from VP of Platform Security' detail in variant F is unconfirmed but the core is real.

c60.note: The Oct 16, 2026 press release confirms Leader status for the second year, one of four among 13 vendors, highest on Ability to Execute and furthest on Completeness of Vision.

c61.note: Sept 30, 2026 press releases confirm Mission Callisto, Gong Activate, Enrich, Agent Builder, Deep Mode and Dashboards; within 90 days. Variants A, C, D, E are all consistent with the releases.

c62.note: Release is datelined Las Vegas and names AT&T Business, Anthropic, Cisco, Experian, Snowflake as on-stage customers.

c63.note: Nov 4, 2026 appointment of Chief R&D Officer focused on agentic capabilities, plus Gong Activate; a reasonable question tied to evidence.

c64.note: Gong Enrich expanding the Revenue Graph with third-party data is confirmed; the integration friction and licensing cost angle is an inference with no cited evidence of such complaints.
